text:
Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Driftwood Mirror, 36" H, Distressed White
Colors: Glass
Materials: Stone
Sun-bleached driftwood is the inspiration for this mirror. Precision-cut pieces of wood come together to create a rustic-style frame, finished in a subtle whitewash for a lightly distressed effect. It arrives ready to hang, all hardware included. 1.5"D x 36"W x 36"H Natural and engineered woods, glass Use glass cleaner for mirror. Wipe frame with soft dry cloth. Hanging hardware included.
